events.evidence: Russian missile and drone attacks resume across Ukraine, killing at least six people
Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov warns the United States and other NATO members against giving Ukraine approval to use long-range missiles
The Israeli military and Shin Bet announce they have rescued Qaid Farhan Al-Qadi, a Bedouin Arab hostage

label.note: Renewed Russian strikes and NATO warning push risk lower; hostage rescue is a rare positive but conflict remains the driver.
